author: Ben1804
quote: Maybe this is a great Sims game, and I have to admit, the open world and attention to detail are genuinely impressive. But why on earth is this called GTA? Where’s the chaos, the action, and the dark humor that made GTA what it is? The story is extremely disappointing, and the GTA feeling is almost nonexistent.Calling this GTA makes about as much sense as calling Elden Ring a shooter. 1 Point is for the good open world. The story and GTA feeling are a massive disappointment.
